checked: Read the full HTML-stripped PBI description (130949.desc.txt, 824 lines: US-001 visitor display/download, US-002 CMS management, both AC prose blocks, edge/negative/post-conditions, all seven field-level tables, Permissions table, Business Rules, Figma link list) clause by clause against all 88 inventory rows, the 21 reductions and all 168 cases in .claude/qa-runs/130949.json.
a0_note: A-0 CAN BE RETIRED: the description file now exists at C:/Users/MahmoudSamy/.claude/projects/d--Ai-QatarChamber/baa964ef-4d8c-44e3-a433-6dad1908077c/tool-results/130949.desc.txt and was read end to end. It confirms the scope the set was built against: two user stories (public display + CMS management), the same objects (hero, quick-facts, section index 01-03, Overview body + info cards, Service information groups + bullet items, downloadable resources), the same lifecycle (Draft/Published/Unpublished + preview), the same three roles, the same bilingual EN/AR + LTR/RTL and desktop/tablet/mobile requirements, and the same char-limit table (eyebrow 60, page title 100, fact label 60, fact value 120, section title 100, card title 100, group label 120, group item 300, resource title 200, download label 40), the same hero banner rule (JPG/PNG/SVG < 2 MB) and the same resource rule (PDF, 5 MB). has_ac remains FALSE (the Azure AC field is literally 'No AC'); the Given/When/Then prose lives in the description body and stays routed to OBJ/FLD/CTL/ST/ROL/MSG/SUR/LNG/ENV rows — zero AC-n rows were added. A-0 nevertheless predicted exactly the residue found: the raw description carries SIX field-level rows the brief did not summarise (Quick-Facts Icon, Overview Card Icon, Section Badge EN/AR, Section Numbering, Created Date, Last Modified Date), one required/optional flag the brief got wrong (Group Intro is Required = No), one field the brief folded into Display Order (Section Numbering), one narrower role wording (Site Content Author = 'View and update assigned page/section content where permitted' — no create, no submit-for-review), one untested rich-text capability ('headings, paragraphs, bullets and inline hyperlinks') and one untested navigation step (Main Menu > Services > Proposal for Research). CONFIRMED UNCHANGED by the PBI text, with no contradiction: the auto-captured File Type and File Size system fields (FLD-27/FLD-28 correct), the 'document shall be replaceable without unpublishing the page' rule (CTL-15/ST-12/TC-034 correct), the PDF-only 5 MB resource constraint (FLD-26 correct), and the 300-char group-item bullet limit (FLD-22 correct). Retire A-0 and replace it with the merged rows and the two open decisions in 'contradictions' below.

gaps.pbi_statement: Icon | Icon/Image | Yes | Allowed icon set | Tile icon (Quick-Facts Tile table)
gaps.why_missing: The quick-facts tile inventory carries Label (FLD-6), Value (FLD-7), Display Order (FLD-8) and Active Status (FLD-9) but no Icon field, even though the PBI marks it mandatory with an allowed-icon-set validation. No case selects, renders or rejects a tile icon.

gaps.pbi_statement: Card Icon | Icon/Image | Yes | Allowed icon set | Card icon (Overview — Body + Info Card table); and 'each active info card shall show its icon, title and description in order'
gaps.why_missing: The Overview info card inventory carries Title (FLD-14), Description (FLD-15), Display Order (FLD-16) and Active Status (FLD-17) but no Card Icon field. TC-006 asserts card titles and descriptions only; the AC explicitly requires the icon to render.

gaps.pbi_statement: Section Badge EN/AR | Text | Yes | Max 100 chars | Section badge / eyebrow (e.g., “About the service”) | 100
gaps.why_missing: Section Badge appears as a mandatory 100-char field in THREE field tables (Overview, Service Information, Downloadable Resources) and is asserted only as a rendered string in the UI cases TC-005/TC-007/TC-010. No inventory row and therefore no field-level validation coverage (empty, whitespace, max, max+1) exists for it.

gaps.pbi_statement: Section Numbering | Text | Yes | Numbering “01, 02, 03” | Section Numbering (Section Index / Section table)
gaps.why_missing: The PBI defines Section Numbering as its own mandatory AUTHORED text field, separate from Display Order. The inventory has no row for it and instead folds the rendered 01/02/03 numerals into FLD-11 (Display Order) — see the contradiction entry. No case authors, validates or renders the numbering value independently.

gaps.pbi_statement: Created / Last Modified Date | System | Yes | Auto | Audit fields (Page / Hero table)
gaps.why_missing: The PBI lists Created Date and Last Modified Date as mandatory auto-captured system fields on the page record. The inventory covers the audit LOG (ST-13, TC-164) and the two auto-captured RESOURCE system fields (FLD-27/FLD-28, TC-104/TC-105) but has no row for the page-level Created / Last Modified audit fields, so the same auto-capture rule that produced TC-104/TC-105 was never applied here.

gaps.pbi_statement: Then rich text shall support headings, paragraphs, bullets and inline hyperlinks
gaps.why_missing: Hero Description and Overview Body are typed Rich Text with the validation 'Headings, bullets, links', and the AC states the capability explicitly. Existing cases TC-086..TC-091 only assert that a plain valid value saves and that empty/whitespace is blocked; nothing exercises the rich-text formatting capability or asserts that an inline hyperlink renders as a working anchor on the public page.

gaps.pbi_statement: Visitor navigates to Main Menu → Services → Proposal for Research.
gaps.why_missing: Step 1 of the stated Frontend Workflow. Every existing visitor case enters the page by typing the URL directly (A-17 flags the URL itself as derived). No case verifies that the page is reachable from the site's main menu under Services — the actual entry point a visitor uses.

gaps.pbi_statement: Hero Banner | Image Upload | Yes | JPG/PNG/SVG < 2 MB | Hero illustration
gaps.why_missing: The hero banner is mandatory, but the budget rule applied to file fields (valid + disallowed type + oversize) produced TC-098/TC-099/TC-100 and no REQUIRED-ness case. Nothing verifies that the record cannot be saved/published with no hero banner attached.

gaps.pbi_statement: Resource File | File Upload (single) | Yes | PDF— 5MB | Downloadable document
gaps.why_missing: Same gap on the resource item: TC-101/TC-102/TC-103 cover valid, disallowed type and oversize, but no case verifies that a resource item with NO file attached is rejected — which matters because an active file-less resource item would publish a Download button pointing at nothing.

gaps.pbi_statement: Group Intro EN/AR | Rich Text | No | Plain/rich | Intro above the group’s bullets
gaps.why_missing: The PBI marks Group Intro as the ONLY optional field in the whole feature. The artifact treats it as mandatory (see the contradiction entry), so the positive optional behaviour — saving and publishing a group with no intro, and the group rendering its label and bullets without an empty intro block — is untested.

contradictions.artifact_says: "Information Group Intro EN/AR — Rich Text, mandatory, no stated max" — and cases TC-096 ('an empty Information Group Intro blocks the save') and TC-097 ('a whitespace-only Information Group Intro blocks the save') assert that the save is blocked and the field is flagged as required.
contradictions.pbi_says: Group Intro EN/AR | Rich Text | No | Plain/rich | Intro above the group’s bullets | —
contradictions.fix: Change FLD-19 to 'Information Group Intro EN/AR — Rich Text, OPTIONAL (Required = No per the PBI field table), no stated max'. TC-096 and TC-097 assert the opposite of the PBI and must be DELETED (or inverted); the new TC-190 replaces them by asserting that an empty Group Intro saves, publishes and renders the group label plus bullets with no empty intro block. Net effect on the budget: line 2 drops from 4 mandatory rich-text fields to 3 (12 -> 9 cases) plus 1 optional-field case, i.e. delivered moves 168 -> 168 - 2 (TC-096, TC-097) + 22 new = 188 if the Manager removes both.

contradictions.artifact_says: "Section Display Order — Number, mandatory, positive integer (drives the rendered 01/02/03 numerals)" — and TC-145 'Verify that reordering sections changes both the page order and the index numerals' asserts that a reorder rewrites the rendered numerals.
contradictions.pbi_says: Section Numbering | Text | Yes | Numbering “01, 02, 03” | Section Numbering  ...  Display Order | Number | Yes | Positive integer | Order
contradictions.fix: Numbering and Display Order are TWO separate mandatory fields in the PBI: the numeral is authored text, the order is a number. Strip the parenthetical '(drives the rendered 01/02/03 numerals)' from FLD-11 and add FLD-35 for the authored Section Numbering. TC-145 must be narrowed to assert the rendered SEQUENCE of sections and index entries only, not that the numerals themselves are rewritten; the new TC-182 asserts the PBI behaviour (authored numbering is preserved across a reorder). If the client actually wants auto-numbering, this is a product decision — flag it rather than silently keeping TC-145 as written.

contradictions.artifact_says: "Site Content Author — creates and edits assigned content, submits for review, no direct publish".
contradictions.pbi_says: Site Content Author (Site Role) | View and update assigned page/section content where permitted.
contradictions.fix: The PBI grants the Author VIEW and UPDATE only — it grants no create capability and mentions no submit-for-review workflow anywhere in the document. Narrow ROL-3 to 'Site Content Author — views and updates assigned page/section content where permitted; no create, no publish, no unpublish'. TC-028 (edit and save as draft) and TC-029 (cannot publish) both remain valid under the narrower wording; no new case was invented for a create/submit-for-review denial because the PBI states no such boundary and inventing one would be invented scope. Confirm with the product owner whether Authors are meant to create records at all.

contradictions.artifact_says: "Section Title EN/AR — Text, mandatory, max 100 (drives both the sticky index entry label and the section heading)" — TC-056 and TC-059 assert one field feeding both places.
contradictions.pbi_says: Section Title EN/AR | Text | Yes | Max 100 chars | Section heading (e.g., “Overview”) | 100   ...   Section Badge EN/AR | Text | Yes | Max 100 chars | Section badge / eyebrow
contradictions.fix: Not a limit/flag error — FLD-10's type, required flag and 100-char limit all match the PBI. The only correction is completeness: the section-level tables carry a SECOND mandatory 100-char text field (Section Badge) that FLD-10 does not cover. Keep FLD-10 as is and add FLD-34; no existing case needs changing.
